# RISK L.L.C.

> RISK L.L.C. is a visa and immigration consulting company founded in 2022 in San Francisco, California, by Sarvar Rakhmanov. We help clients worldwide (especially from Uzbekistan and the CIS) prepare visa and immigration applications. We are not a law firm and cannot guarantee approvals. Support is available 24/7 in English, Russian and Uzbek.

## Services
- USA: B1/B2 tourist and business visas, F-1/J-1/M-1 student visas, H-1B, L-1, O-1, K-1, family and employment green cards, DV lottery, adjustment of status, RFE responses, work permits (EAD)
- Canada: visitor visa (TRV), business visitor, super visa, study permit, work permits, Express Entry PR, PNP, family sponsorship
- United Kingdom: Standard Visitor, Student visa, Skilled Worker
- Japan: eVisa / temporary visitor visas
- Australia: Visitor visa (subclass 600, Tourist and Business Visitor streams), Student visa (subclass 500)
- Brazil: visitor visa and e-visa guidance
- Business visas based on conference invitations; student admissions (bachelor's, master's, ESL, community college)
